title: io.loams.dev.usage.git.storage.v1
description: The `data` of a `io.loams.dev.usage.git.storage.v1` usage event: A repository's stored bytes (a gauge, D393). Producer: Loams Git. Design §63 §6.3. Measured values are integers in the unit named; dimensions are strings. New optional fields may be added within v1.
